title: Statistics for Data Science II
standfirst: Sampling, estimation, hypothesis testing and the beginnings of statistical inference.

description_paragraphs: This second course builds on the introductory statistics course, further exploring key statistical problems and their solution methods.
faculty: Prof. Andrew Thangaraj, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Multiple random variables - joint, marginal, conditional PMFs; Conditioning and examples.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Independence of random variables; Functions and visualisation (one and two variables); Sum, minimum and maximum; Examples.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Expectation (properties, simulation); Variance and standard deviation; Covariance and correlation; Probability bounds.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Continuous random variables - CDF, PDF; Discrete vs continuous; Approximation; Common distributions; Colab illustrations.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Continuous random variables - functions and expectations; Joint distributions (discrete and continuous); Motivation.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Jointly continuous random variables; Marginal and conditional densities; Independence; From data to distributions; 1D/2D histograms (Colab).

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Statistics from i.i.d. samples; Empirical distribution and descriptive statistics; Sum of independent random variables; Data illustrations.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Moment generating functions; Central Limit Theorem; Distributions and properties; Descriptive statistics of normal samples.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Parameter estimation; Error, bias, variance and risk; Method of moments and maximum likelihood estimation; Evaluation of ML estimators; Real-life statistical problems.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Bayesian estimation; Choice of priors; Estimation problems; Model estimation.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Hypothesis testing - introduction and types; Size and power of tests; z-test and p-value; Problem solving and data-based inference.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: t-test (mean, unknown variance); Chi-squared test (variance); Two-sample tests (z/F); Tests for normal samples; Problem solving.
